name: Spoony, Emotional, Lustful, Fatherly Love
source:
A story for gay furry men who have no friends and remain unloved.

How are we suppose to go through the day by day grind of life when nobody cares about you? Why does it feel like everyone is happy except for you? How do we grow and learn from relationships that don't even exist in the first place?

Well, if you can't find love out in the wild, Homemade is fine, too.

[From [url=https://dragonierzapp.itch.io/spoony-emotional-lustful-fatherly-love]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一个关于没有朋友、不被爱的同性恋毛茸茸男人的故事。

当没有人关心你的时候，我们该如何度过日复一日的生活？为什么感觉每个人都很开心，除了你？我们如何从根本不存在的关系中成长和学习？

好吧，如果你在野外找不到爱情，自制也不错。

[来自[url=https://dragonierzapp.itch.io/spoony-emotional-lustful-fatherly-love]Itch.io[/url]]
